project_info.theme: Minimal winter Christmas fashion magazine cover
project_info.color_palette: light gray, white, black, vivid red, warm wood brown

main_subject.detail: The specific approved adult character sits full-body on a tall wooden stool, wearing a black turtleneck and jeans, with a long red scarf flowing down, subtle reindeer antlers and a red Christmas bauble suspended above her open hand.
main_subject.style: clean high-fashion editorial with natural skin texture and sophisticated restraint

composition_elements.layout: vertical magazine cover with generous negative space, model seated slightly below the masthead
composition_elements.text: Magazine masthead may use an approved Vogue or Elle reference only when licensed; otherwise use a generic high-fashion masthead. Secondary line: WINTER MINIMALISM.
items: solid light-gray or white seamless paper background
snowflake light patterns projected onto wall
red scarf falls from lap to floor
single red bauble hangs from a string above hand

lighting_and_atmosphere.type: large directional softbox at 4800K from camera-left with black flag and subtle white fill
lighting_and_atmosphere.effect: clean light, defined but soft shadows, cool winter atmosphere and controlled red accents

technical_specs.render_style: Nikon Z8, NIKKOR Z 85mm f/1.2 S, high-fashion magazine photography
technical_specs.optics: moderate shallow depth of field, crisp textile detail and restrained editorial grain

prompt.generated_prompt_string: Magazine cover layout, minimalist composition, negative space. A full-body studio shot of the specific approved adult character sitting on a tall stool. Critical: ensure the face is exactly the same as the approved reference. Styling: minimalist chic outfit with black turtleneck and jeans, a long red scarf flowing down, and subtle reindeer antlers. Props: a single red Christmas bauble hanging from a string right above her hand. Snowflake light patterns projected on the background wall. Background: solid light grey or white seamless paper. Lighting: soft, directional light creating a clean look with defined shadows. Style: high-fashion magazine editorial, clean lines, modern and sophisticated.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, watermark, extra fingers, deformed, duplicate baubles, distorted masthead, cluttered layout, altered approved face likeness
